artifact_inventory.description: Symbolic verification of the local generalized-trigonometric series and ratio coefficients.

limitations: The result disproves Conjecture 4.1 for \(1<p\le(1+\sqrt7)/3\). It does not determine the global monotonicity range above that local obstruction threshold.
record_title: A local asymptotic obstruction to Huang–Yin–Wang–Lin Conjecture 4.1
